Pre-operative BMI was 46.92 kg/m^(2); the operation was uneventful with no obvious concerning hepatic surface changes noted intraoperatively.

Approximately 1.5 years after surgery BMI was 29.87 kg/m^(2); a contrast CT abdomen/pelvis obtained for persistent nausea and emesis showed no evidence of hepatic lesions. Table 1 lists 77.8% excess weight loss, post-op HA 0 cm and an imaging interval of 36 months that is not reconciled with the narrative timing.

The narrative findings are kept as literal supported observations; the Table 1 sizes are review_only. The CT lesion is never called an adenoma, and the Table 1 post-op value (7.5-month interval) may refer to different imaging; do not reconcile.

article_limitations: Roster is the three institutional patients (A-C) only. The seven literature patients (Table 2 image MO3; narratives in b00028-b00032) come from previously published reports and are cited external cases, not index patients; their facts are not accepted here.

Table 1 imaging intervals (36, 48 and 7.5 months) have no stated anchor and differ from narrative post-operative imaging times (about 1.5 years, 16 months, 18 months); not reconciled. Patient C Table 1 hepatic adenoma sizes (1.00 cm pre- and post-op) conflict with narrative 1.3 cm (CT) and 1.1 cm (MRI).

Hepatic adenomas are imaging-based; no histology, subtype, or pre-operative symptoms beyond right flank pain (Patient A) are reported. Obesity is not stated as a per-patient diagnosis; BMI values are recorded as observations only.

Annotation figures[] keep caption-level fields only; pixel inspection of Figures 1-3 and the Table 2 image (MO3) is recorded in the visual submission. Supplements MOESM1-3 are DOCX files (STROBE checklist, record-screening keywords/ICD codes, JBI appraisal of cited studies) with no patient-level content; they are covered by the supplement manifest only because the PDF/image supplement review contracts do not support DOCX.

Weight-loss association with adenoma regression is a cohort-level statistical finding and does not establish individual causation. Two institutional patients with HA but no post-operative imaging are not described individually (b00018).
